recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-11133. If Patient Care wants to retire or rewrite the remaining STU feedback note, handle that as a separate editorial/work-group decision because this seed's published modified resolution is already represented in active source.
issue_request: FHIR-11133 was Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care feedback supporting use of CodeableConcept/Condition.code to report no known conditions rather than relying on a List.emptyReason-only problem list representation. Its final resolution pointed to GF#8749 and required adding SNOMED CT 160245001 "No current problems or disability (situation)" to the condition.code value set definition.
initial_application: No separate FHIR-11133-tagged source commit was found. Jira points to GF#8749, and historical commit afcde8c93515a0c8879ccce26779347a15c7bd36 implemented that change by adding SNOMED CT 160245001 to source/condition/valueset-condition-code.xml and Condition.code/no-known-problems guidance to source/condition/condition-notes.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-8749 is the original same-change-family Patient Care issue and FHIR-11100 is parallel ballot feedback supporting the same CodeableConcept approach. Current source/fhir.ini lists Condition as active Patient Care-owned source, and Condition.code binds to ValueSet/condition-code. The current notes still describe List.emptyReason for full-list or not-asked statements, but the accepted resolution was Persuasive with Modification and added the Condition.code code/guidance rather than removing every List.emptyReason mention. Later source maintenance preserved the STU note wording, and 2025 Patient Care minutes cite the current Condition page and value set during a negation discussion without contradicting the current source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the active source already includes code 160245001 in the Condition code value set and states that Condition.code can capture "no known problems" or negated conditions, with code preferred when condition/problem data should be queryable as Condition instances.
